# Jadel Tech RD

> Governed AI automation, agentic systems, API integration, observability and production-readiness engineering.

Canonical site: https://jadeltechrd.com/
Project intake: https://jadeltechrd.com/solicitar-proyecto.html
Machine-readable service catalog: https://jadeltechrd.com/agent-services.json
Privacy: https://jadeltechrd.com/?view=privacy
Terms: https://jadeltechrd.com/?view=terms
Data deletion: https://jadeltechrd.com/?view=data-deletion
Nexus automation profile: nexus_ai_automation_v0.3.0

## Commercial capabilities

- Agentic architecture and AI automation
- API, webhook and business-process integrations
- Support/ticket agents with human escalation
- Sales and lead intelligence
- Dashboards and decision intelligence
- AI governance and production readiness
- Multi-agent orchestration
- Revenue opportunity intelligence
- Governed Nexus intake, quote, PayPal order, ledger, approval and work-order coordination

## Interaction and authority

Public discovery is read-only. Project creation uses the governed human intake.
External submission, contract acceptance, production deployment and financial
execution are not autonomous capabilities.

The current commercial payment flow is human-controlled. Machine-payment
capabilities are experimental/testnet until separately certified and promoted.
nexus_ai_automation_v0.3.0 may prepare briefs, scoring, proposals, work orders,
evidence packets and dashboards, but critical external actions require human
approval and private runtime authorization.

## Agent interoperability

MCP is used as a tool/interoperability pattern in supported projects.
An A2A Agent Card is intentionally not published until a conformant A2A endpoint
is available on the public domain.

## Evidence and claims

Service maturity and pricing are described in the machine-readable service
catalog. No claim of guaranteed income, customer ROI, autonomous financial
authority or production deployment should be inferred from this discovery file.
